name: @cwertlinks/common
description: common utilities for the ticketing project

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(common): release %s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(common): release %s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore(common): release %s" && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
